CVE-2026-33870 is a high-severity HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in Netty's chunked transfer encoding parser, fixed in 4.1.132.Final. Netty dependencies in the logstash image are bundled within upstream logstash plugins (logstash-input-http, logstash-input-beats, logstash-input-tcp) and are not directly controllable at the image definition level. Waiting for upstream Elastic plugin maintainers to update their netty dependencies.
